# DYC Projects

> DYC Projects is a Sydney technology consultancy that designs, builds, migrates and runs secure, scalable cloud and software systems for Australian businesses.

Contact: 0451 836 661 · info@dycprojects.com.au
Location: Ryde NSW, Australia

## Pages
- [DYC Projects](https://dycprojects.com.au/): Cloud migration, custom software and DevOps for growing Australian businesses. Secure systems on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, explained in plain English. Book a free consultation.
- [Services](https://dycprojects.com.au/services/): Cloud architecture and migration, custom software development, DevOps and automation, managed cloud, cloud security and technical consulting for Australian businesses.
- [Cloud Architecture and Migration (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)](https://dycprojects.com.au/services/cloud-architecture-migration/): Plan and run secure, cost effective moves to Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, including hybrid setups. Assessment, architecture, migration and ongoing optimisation.
- [Custom Software Development](https://dycprojects.com.au/services/custom-software-development/): Web applications, internal business tools, APIs and system integrations built around the way your business works. Based in Sydney, working across Australia.
- [DevOps and Automation](https://dycprojects.com.au/services/devops-automation/): CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, containerisation and automated deployments that speed up delivery and reduce errors.
